title: Announcing Every + Sutter Law: Full-Service Legal for High-Growth Startups
summary: As your startup grows, legal needs stack up fast. Learn how Every and Sutter Law are partnering to provide startups with the full back office and legal foundation they need to incorporate, operate, and scale.
body_markdown:
As your company grows, legal needs stack up fast. One week it's a last-minute employment contract, the next it's a SAFE you're drafting for a big investor meeting.


As many of startups’ legal needs fall under different domains, founders often end up working with a patchwork of legal specialists to stay compliant across the board. But founders should be building their companies, not managing a roster of outside lawyers.


That's why Every is partnering with[Sutter Law](https://sutterlegal.com/) , a business and transactional law firm built for startups and emerging companies.


## Introducing the Every + Sutter Law Partnership


The Every and Sutter Law partnership provides startups with the full back office and legal foundation they need to incorporate, operate, and scale.


Every’s AI-native finance and HR platform offers tooling for everything from banking and payroll to benefits, taxes, and compliance—all under one roof. Built for founders and operators at high-growth companies, Every simplifies and automates key back-office workflows so that you can scale with confidence.


Sutter Law is a Silicon Valley-based business law firm designed to support the legal requirements of growing companies. With nine attorneys, each with a legal specialty and deep technology-sector experience, Sutter can handle everything that a growing company needs, including employment law, financing, M&A, contract drafting & review, and IP. Supporting over 1,000 active clients, Sutter enables founders to get the legal guidance they need with transparency, clarity and simplicity, and without having to be referred out time and time again.


Together, Every and Sutter provide founders with centralized solutions for their back office and legal needs. "Founders should be focused on building their companies, not chasing down a different firm for every legal question,” says[Eric H. Milliken](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emilliken/) , attorney and managing partner at Sutter Law. “Partnering with Every lets us do that from the very beginning, so companies have both their operational and legal foundation handled as they grow."


## Grow Confidently with Every + Sutter Law


Few things are more valuable to a startup than its founder's time. Hours spent wrangling complex, disconnected processes across back office and legal are hours pulled away from fundraising, product strategy, and sales. Simplifying your operations with Every and Sutter Law means less time juggling vendors, fewer costly legal mistakes, and more headspace to build.


Think Every and Sutter Law could help your business?[Book a time with our team to learn more](https://www.every.io/get-started) .
